var authGuard = () => {
  const auth = inject(AuthService);
  const router = inject(Router);

// src/app/core/auth/idle-timeout.service.ts
import { Injectable, NgZone, inject as inject2, signal } from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/@angular_core.js?v=1f00211f";
import * as i0 from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/@angular_core.js?v=1f00211f";
var IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 6e4;
var ACTIVITY_EVENTS = ["mousemove", "click", "keydown", "scroll"];
var IdleTimeoutService = class _IdleTimeoutService {
  auth = inject2(AuthService);
  zone = inject2(NgZone);
  isPromptOpen = signal(
    false,
    ...ngDevMode ? [{ debugName: "isPromptOpen" }] : (
      /* istanbul ignore next */
      []
    )
  );
  timerId = null;
  listenersBound = false;
  boundRecordActivity = () => this.recordActivity();
  start() {
    if (this.listenersBound)
      return;
    this.listenersBound = true;
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => window.addEventListener(eventName, this.boundRecordActivity, { passive: true }));
    });
    this.startTimer();
  }
  stop() {
    this.clearTimer();
    if (this.listenersBound) {
      ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach((eventName) => window.removeEventListener(eventName, this.boundRecordActivity));
      this.listenersBound = false;
    }
    this.isPromptOpen.set(false);
  }
  /** Called by the "Continue" button: dismiss the prompt and restart the clock. */
  continueSession() {
    this.isPromptOpen.set(false);
    this.startTimer();
  }
  /** Called by the "Logout" button (or auto-triggered choice). */
  async logoutNow() {
    this.stop();
    await this.auth.logout();
  }
  recordActivity() {
    if (!this.isPromptOpen()) {
      this.startTimer();
    }
  }
  startTimer() {
    this.clearTimer();
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
        this.zone.run(() => this.isPromptOpen.set(true));
      }, IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    });
  }
  clearTimer() {
    if (this.timerId !== null) {
      clearTimeout(this.timerId);
      this.timerId = null;
    }
  }
  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.stop();
  }
  static \u0275fac = function IdleTimeoutService_Factory(__ngFactoryType__) {
    return new (__ngFactoryType__ || _IdleTimeoutService)();
  };
  static \u0275prov = /* @__PURE__ */ i0.\u0275\u0275defineInjectable({ token: _IdleTimeoutService, factory: _IdleTimeoutService.\u0275fac, providedIn: "root" });
};

  }], null, null);
})();

      },
      {
        path: "reports",
        loadComponent: () => import("/chunk-DMNRIWUG.js").then((m) => m.ReportsPageComponent)
      },
      { path: "**", redirectTo: "dashboard" }
    ]
  }
];

// src/app/core/auth/auth.interceptor.ts
import { inject as inject5 } from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/@angular_core.js?v=1f00211f";
var authInterceptor = (req, next) => {
  const auth = inject5(AuthService);
  const authHeader = auth.authHeader;
  if (!authHeader) {
    return next(req);
  }
  return next(
    req.clone({
      setHeaders: { Authorization: authHeader }
    })
  );
};

// src/app/core/auth/error.interceptor.ts
import { inject as inject6 } from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/@angular_core.js?v=1f00211f";
import { Router as Router2 } from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/@angular_router.js?v=1f00211f";
import { catchError, throwError } from "/@fs/C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/RetailBus/RetailBussiness/frontend/.angular/cache/22.1.8/frontend/vite/deps/rxjs.js?v=1f00211f";
var errorInterceptor = (req, next) => {
  const router = inject6(Router2);
  const auth = inject6(AuthService);
  return next(req).pipe(
    catchError((error) => {
      if (error.status === 401 && auth.isAuthenticated()) {
        void auth.logout();
        router.navigate(["/login"]);
      }
      return throwError(() => error);
    })
  );
};

// src/app/app.config.ts
var appConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners(),
    provideRouter(routes),
    provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor, errorInterceptor]))
  ]
};
